recognize_zh: 周邊血中一顆偏心圓核、染色質呈塊狀（clock-face 樣）的漿細胞，細胞質深藍色，外緣呈紫紅色、邊界不規則如火焰般（flame cell），在骨髓瘤復發病人代表循環中的異常漿細胞。
features: Medium-sized cell larger than adjacent red cells with moderate N:C ratio
Eccentric round nucleus with coarsely clumped chromatin
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a reddish-purple (fuchsinophilic) frayed peripheral rim, characteristic of a flame cell
Background red cells; image has a color cast and limited resolution
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a circulating plasma cell with an eccentric round nucleus with coarsely clumped chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm. The cytoplasmic periphery has a reddish-purple, frayed appearance characteristic of flame cell morphology. The image has a color cast and limited resolution, so a perinuclear hof is not clearly assessable. In a patient with relapsed multiple myeloma, findings are consistent with circulating abnormal plasma cells of flame cell type; quantification on smear or flow cytometry is needed to determine whether criteria for plasma cell leukemia are met (≥5% circulating plasma cells).

ddx.vs: Reactive plasmacytoid lymphocytes in infections are smaller with less eccentric nuclei and lack the fuchsinophilic frayed rim, and are polyclonal on flow cytometry.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.
Plasmablasts are larger with fine chromatin and prominent nucleoli rather than clumped mature chromatin.
Promyelocytes have azurophilic granules and a perinuclear clearing but lack clumped chromatin and flame-colored cytoplasm, and are MPO positive.
